reuse.why: The change reuses recurrence construction and weekend adjustment helpers, but independently implements daily occurrence policy in three consumers.

duplication.why: getNextDate, getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange repeat the daily-frequency decision, nonworking-day filtering and conditional date adjustment.

placement.why: Holiday matching belongs appropriately in shared/schedules.ts, but server handlers also own recurrence policy that should live alongside those shared helpers.

scope.why: The edits are focused on the four requested scheduling changes, their tests and release notes.

maintainability.why: Maintainers must coordinate several implementations of the same occurrence policy and separate holiday-dependent enumeration bounds.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/schedules/app.ts: getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange enumerate raw occurrences and independently reproduce policy implemented in shared/schedules.ts:getNextDate.

disguised_duplication.where: The filter/map pipeline in getUpcomingDates and continue/conditional loop in getDatesInRange reshape the same daily filtering and adjustment decisions implemented in getNextDate.

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains a holidays parameter; getNextDate adds daily-specific lookahead, filtering and adjustment exclusion; getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange independently implement that policy.
